name: Tikal National Park
description: Deep in the rainforest of Guatemala's Petén region, Tikal was once the capital of one of the most powerful Maya kingdoms. Its stepped temples and palaces rise above the jungle canopy, linked by plazas and ramps, and the city was inhabited for roughly 1,500 years before being abandoned around the 10th century. Today it sits within a 570-square-kilometre park of forest, savanna and wetland.
